Deliverable: Cross-Source Report
Descriptive context only; these labels add no answer requirements: Role=Archive Reviewer; Case=Print Supply Verification.

Use only the provided archive. Complete exactly and only the compiled items below.

1. Q01
Cross-check the contracted fields and report only archive-supported conclusions: Worcester Print Works current_plate_stock_level (unit: sets); Teme Valley Inks supplier_contract_status.
Cite the visible archive source title for every reported fact in this item.

2. Q02
Determine and report the contracted fields: Worcester Print Works has_operational_status; Severn Paper Mills supplier_contract_status; Teme Valley Inks supplier_contract_status; Malvern Plate & Imaging supplier_contract_status; Worcester Print Works annual_newsprint_consumption_2025 (unit: tonnes); Worcester Print Works current_newsprint_stock_level (unit: tonnes); Worcester Print Works current_ink_stock_level (unit: litres); Worcester Print Works current_plate_stock_level (unit: sets).
Cite the visible archive source title for every reported fact in this item.

Do not infer or add complementary fields that are not listed in these compiled items.

- "field_01" — covers only: Worcester Print Works has_operational_status.
- "field_02" — covers only: Severn Paper Mills supplier_contract_status.
- "field_03" — covers only: Teme Valley Inks supplier_contract_status.

- "field_07" — covers only: Worcester Print Works current_ink_stock_level (unit: litres).
- "field_08" — covers only: Worcester Print Works current_plate_stock_level (unit: sets).

Each key maps to an array with one entry per listed fact. Every entry must contain "predicate", "value", "unit", "validity", "authority", and "source_title". Use null for "source_title" only when no compiled item for that fact requires a citation.
